ESV.1: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the clans of Manasseh the son of Joseph. The names of his daughters were: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
ESV.2: And they stood before Moses and before Eleazar the priest and before the chiefs and all the congregation, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying,
ESV.3: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but died for his own sin. And he had no sons.
ESV.4: Why should the name of our father be taken away from his clan because he had no son? Give to us a possession among our father's brothers.”
ESV.5: Moses brought their case before the LORD.
ESV.6: And the LORD said to Moses,
ESV.7: “The daughters of Zelophehad are right. You shall give them possession of an inheritance among their father's brothers and transfer the inheritance of their father to them.
ESV.8: And you shall speak to the people of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
ESV.9: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
ESV.10: And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.
ESV.11: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the nearest kinsman of his clan, and he shall possess it. And it shall be for the people of Israel a statute and rule, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”
ESV.12: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim and see the land that I have given to the people of Israel.
ESV.13: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,
ESV.14: because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin when the congregation quarreled, failing to uphold me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
ESV.15: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
ESV.16: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation
ESV.17: who shall go out before them and come in before them, who shall lead them out and bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep that have no shepherd.”
ESV.18: So the LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
ESV.19: Make him stand before Eleazar the priest and all the congregation, and you shall commission him in their sight.
ESV.20: You shall invest him with some of your authority, that all the congregation of the people of Israel may obey.
ESV.21: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the people of Israel with him, the whole congregation.”
ESV.22: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and made him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation,
ESV.23: and he laid his hands on him and commissioned him as the LORD directed through Moses.

NASB.4: 'Why should the name of our father be withdrawn from among his family because he had no son? Give us a possession among our father's brothers.'

NASB.15: Then Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

NASB.19: and have him stand before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and commission him in their sight.
NASB.20: 'You shall put some of your authority on him, in order that all the congregation of the sons of Israel may obey [him].
NASB.21: 'Moreover, he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his command they shall go out and at his command they shall come in, [both] he and the sons of Israel with him, even all the congregation.'
NASB.22: Moses did just as the LORD commanded him; and he took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
NASB.23: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.

NKJV.1: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, from the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
NKJV.2: And they stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the leaders and all the congregation, by the doorway of the tabernacle of meeting, saying:
NKJV.3: “Our father died in the wilderness; but he was not in the company of those who gathered together against the LORD, in company with Korah, but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.
NKJV.4: Why should the name of our father be removed from among his family because he had no son? Give us a possession among our father’s brothers.”
NKJV.5: So Moses brought their case before the LORD.
NKJV.6: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
NKJV.7: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak what is right; you shall surely give them a possession of inheritance among their father’s brothers, and cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
NKJV.8: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
NKJV.9: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
NKJV.10: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
NKJV.11: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the relative closest to him in his family, and he shall possess it.’ ” And it shall be to the children of Israel a statute of judgment, just as the LORD commanded Moses.
NKJV.12: Now the LORD said to Moses: “Go up into this Mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
NKJV.13: And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered.
NKJV.14: For in the Wilderness of Zin, during the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against My command to hallow Me at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah, at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.)
NKJV.15: Then Moses spoke to the LORD, saying:
NKJV.16: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
NKJV.17: who may go out before them and go in before them, who may lead them out and bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be like sheep which have no shepherd.”
NKJV.18: And the LORD said to Moses: “Take Joshua the son of Nun with you, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him;
NKJV.19: set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and inaugurate him in their sight.
NKJV.20: And you shall give some of your authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
NKJV.21: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire before the LORD for him by the judgment of the Urim. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and all the children of Israel with him—all the congregation.”
NKJV.22: So Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
NKJV.23: And he laid his hands on him and inaugurated him, just as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

NLT.1: One day a petition was presented by the daughters of Zelophehad — Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. Their father, Zelophehad, was a descendant of Hepher son of Gilead, son of Makir, son of Manasseh, son of Joseph.
NLT.2: These women stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the tribal leaders, and the entire community at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
NLT.3: “Our father died in the wilderness,” they said. “He was not among Korah’s followers, who rebelled against the LORD; he died because of his own sin. But he had no sons.
NLT.4: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan just because he had no sons? Give us property along with the rest of our relatives.”
NLT.5: So Moses brought their case before the LORD.
NLT.6: And the LORD replied to Moses,
NLT.7: “The claim of the daughters of Zelophehad is legitimate. You must give them a grant of land along with their father’s relatives. Assign them the property that would have been given to their father.
NLT.8: “And give the following instructions to the people of Israel: If a man dies and has no son, then give his inheritance to his daughters.
NLT.9: And if he has no daughter either, transfer his inheritance to his brothers.
NLT.10: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
NLT.11: But if his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan. This is a legal requirement for the people of Israel, just as the LORD commanded Moses.”
NLT.12: One day the LORD said to Moses, “Climb one of the mountains east of the river, and look out over the land I have given the people of Israel.
NLT.13: After you have seen it, you will die like your brother, Aaron,
NLT.14: for you both rebelled against my instructions in the wilderness of Zin. When the people of Israel rebelled, you failed to demonstrate my holiness to them at the waters.” (These are the waters of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
NLT.15: Then Moses said to the LORD,
NLT.16: “O LORD, you are the God who gives breath to all creatures. Please appoint a new man as leader for the community.
NLT.17: Give them someone who will guide them wherever they go and will lead them into battle, so the community of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”
NLT.18: The LORD replied, “Take Joshua son of Nun, who has the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.
NLT.19: Present him to Eleazar the priest before the whole community, and publicly commission him to lead the people.
NLT.20: Transfer some of your authority to him so the whole community of Israel will obey him.
NLT.21: When direction from the LORD is needed, Joshua will stand before Eleazar the priest, who will use the Urim — one of the sacred lots cast before the LORD — to determine his will. This is how Joshua and the rest of the community of Israel will determine everything they should do.”
NLT.22: So Moses did as the LORD commanded. He presented Joshua to Eleazar the priest and the whole community.
NLT.23: Moses laid his hands on him and commissioned him to lead the people, just as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

CSB17.1: The daughters of Zelophehad approached; Zelophehad was the son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh from the clans of Manasseh, the son of Joseph. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
CSB17.2: They stood before Moses, the priest Eleazar, the leaders, and the entire community at the entrance to the tent of meeting and said,
CSB17.3: “Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among Korah’s followers, who gathered together against the LORD. <sup>ⓙ</sup> Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
CSB17.4: Why should the name of our father be taken away from his clan? Since he had no son, give us property among our father’s brothers.”
CSB17.5: Moses brought their case before the LORD,
CSB17.7: “What Zelophehad’s daughters say is correct. You are to give them hereditary property among their father’s brothers and transfer their father’s inheritance to them. <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.8: Tell the Israelites: When a man dies without having a son, transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
CSB17.9: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
CSB17.10: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
CSB17.11: If his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative of his clan, and he will take possession of it. This is to be a statutory ordinance for the Israelites as the LORD commanded Moses.”
CSB17.12: Then the LORD said to Moses, <sup>ⓛ</sup> “Go up this mountain of the Abarim range <sup>[1]</sup> and see the land that I have given the Israelites.
CSB17.13: After you have seen it, you will also be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was. <sup>ⓜ</sup>
CSB17.14: When the community quarreled in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you rebelled against my command to demonstrate my holiness in their sight at the waters.” Those were the Waters of Meribah-kadesh <sup>[2]</sup> in the Wilderness of Zin. <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.15: So Moses appealed to the LORD,
CSB17.16: “May the LORD, the God who gives breath to all, <sup>[3]</sup> <sup>ⓐ</sup> appoint a man over the community
CSB17.17: who will go out before them and come back in before them, <sup>ⓑ</sup> and who will bring them out and bring them in, so that the LORD’s community won’t be like sheep without a shepherd.” <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.18: The LORD replied to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man who has the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him. <sup>ⓓ</sup>
CSB17.19: Have him stand before the priest Eleazar and the whole community, and commission <sup>ⓔ</sup> him in their sight.
CSB17.20: Confer some of your authority on him so that the entire Israelite community will obey him.
CSB17.21: He will stand before the priest Eleazar who will consult the LORD for him with the decision of the Urim. <sup>ⓕ</sup> He and all the Israelites with him, even the entire community, will go out and come back in at his command.”
CSB17.22: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, had him stand before the priest Eleazar and the entire community,
CSB17.23: laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as the LORD had spoken through Moses.

AMP.7: "The request of the daughters of Zelophehad is justified. You shall certainly give them a possession as an inheritance among their father's brothers, and you shall transfer their father's inheritance to them.
AMP.8: Further, you shall say to the Israelites, 'If a man dies and has no son, you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
AMP.9: If a man has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
AMP.10: If a man has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.
AMP.11: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his nearest relative in his own family, and he shall take possession of it. It shall be a statute and ordinance to the Israelites, just as the LORD has commanded Moses.'"
AMP.12: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go up to this mountain (Nebo) [in the] Abarim [range] and look at the land I have given to the sons of Israel.
AMP.13: When you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people [in death], just as Aaron your brother was gathered;
AMP.14: because in the Wilderness of Zin, during the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against My command to treat me as holy [by following My instruction] before their eyes at the water." (These are the waters of Meribah in Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.)
AMP.15: Then Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
AMP.16: " Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation
AMP.17: who will go out and come in before them, and will lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be as sheep without a shepherd."
AMP.18: The LORD said to Moses, "Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him;
AMP.19: and have him stand before Eleazar the priest and before the whole congregation, and give him a commission in their sight.
AMP.20: You shall put some of your authority and honor on him, so that all the congregation of the Israelites will obey him.
AMP.21: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire before the LORD for him by the judgment (decision) of the Urim. At Joshua's command the people shall go out and at his command they shall come in, he and all the congregation of Israel with him."
AMP.22: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation,
AMP.23: and Moses laid his hands on Joshua and commissioned him, just as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

NIV.1:

NIV.2: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly, and said,
NIV.3: “Our father died in the desert. He was not among Korah’s followers, who banded together against the Lord, but he died for his own sin and left no sons.
NIV.4: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s relatives.”
NIV.5: So Moses brought their case before the Lord
NIV.6: and the Lord said to him,
NIV.7: “What Zelophehad’s daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father’s relatives and turn their father’s inheritance over to them.

NIV.9: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.

NIV.11: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to be a legal requirement for the Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.’”

Joshua to Succeed Moses
Then the Lord said to Moses, “Go up this mountain in the Abarim range and see the land I have given the Israelites.
NIV.13: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,
NIV.14: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes.” (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)
NIV.16: “May the Lord, the God of the spirits of all mankind, appoint a man over this community
NIV.17: to go out and come in before them, one who will lead them out and bring them in, so the Lord’s people will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”
NIV.18: So the Lord said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay your hand on him.
